feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 September 2026 5:27am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 25 September 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over Eastern Europe, and a deep area of low pressure over Iceland bringing a cold front over the area at first.


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, decreasing west or southwest 3 or 4 during this morning, then increasing southwest 4 or 5 this evening, and 5 or 6 in northern parts overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first becoming mainly moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain soon clearing to become mainly fair by midday, only isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, but 5 or 6 in the north of the area at first, then increasing south or southwest 5 or 6 in all waters late Saturday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
